name: Falcon Heavy
description: Three Falcon 9 cores side by side: 27 Merlins at liftoff, carrying a 20 t satellite to low orbit.
notes: The centre core throttles back to try to stay under 4.5 g (an estimate; SpaceX doesn't publish it). The side boosters can't throttle in the sim, so it still peaks near 7 g just before they drop off.
The side boosters burn liquid fuel but are modelled as strap-ons at full thrust until empty. The real ones fly back and land at the Cape.
The real centre core throttles down early to save fuel for after the side boosters leave; the sim runs it at full thrust.
